title: How AI agents can power the S&P 500 higher
title_zh: AI 代理如何助力标普 500 指数走高
summary: AI agents are only getting more powerful.
summary_zh: 人工智能代理只会变得更加强大。

title: Apple tests China's CXMT memory chips for iPhones and MacBooks, WSJ reports
title_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，苹果正在测​​试用于 iPhone 和 MacBook 的中国长鑫存储芯片
summary: Apple has been testing memory chips from China's ‌CXMT across product lines including ‌iPhones and MacBooks, to mitigate a component shortage ​fueled by the AI boom, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》周日报道，苹果一直在 iPhone 和 MacBook 等产品线中测试中国长鑫存储的存储芯片，以缓解人工智能热潮引发的零部件短缺问题。

title: 'Very little to like': Wall Street assesses surprise July jobs report as stocks jump
title_zh: “没什么可喜欢的”：随着股市上涨，华尔街评估了令人惊讶的 7 月份就业报告
summary: The latest monthly jobs report could take the pressure off the Fed to hike rates.
summary_zh: 最新的月度就业报告可能会减轻美联储加息的压力。

title: Rivian's make-or-break R2 midsize EV delivers: Road test
title_zh: Rivian 的成败 R2 中型电动车交付：道路测试
summary: The Rivian R2 is, frankly, the most important vehicle Rivian has ever built. It's the car that's supposed to push Rivian over the edge on cost, scale, and profits.
summary_zh: 坦率地说，Rivian R2 是 Rivian 有史以来制造的最重要的车辆。这款汽车有望将 Rivian 推向成本、规模和利润的边缘。
